caption: The drawing depicts a transparent glass vessel with two curved handles attached to its upper sides. The vessel features a wide, cylindrical neck that flares outward slightly at the rim, which is edged with a darker outline. The handles are symmetrically placed on each side, curving outward and then downward before attaching closer to the vessel’s midsection. The body of the vessel is bulbous and rounded, tapering toward a thick, circular pedestal base. The glass is depicted with subtle shading to indicate its transparency and reflections, using light blue and gray tones. The vessel is centered against a plain, light beige background with a slightly darker rectangular area behind it, likely to emphasize the object. The artist’s name, “John Tarantino,” is written in small letters at the bottom right corner of the drawing.
title: Vase
